review_type: AI visual and content QA of rendered figures; independent of rendering implementation. This is not human evidence screening, eligibility adjudication, risk-of-bias appraisal or formal certainty assessment.

content: Adopted September 16 scope and proposed September 21 operational screening are visibly distinguished.

Mixed-population estimates without separable eligible results are outside primary synthesis; citations and reasons remain retained.

Context remains separate and no completed PRISMA selection flow or finalized counts are claimed.
Final wording says original service/code research involving Medicare, removing ambiguity with the Original Medicare benefit.

content: Coverage/administration, provider payment/valuation and patient burden are parallel domains, not a serial coverage-to-payment-to-cost chain.
All links to access and health are dashed; both subtitle and footer explicitly identify relationships/hypotheses to evaluate.
Retains nonrecipients in the clinical-need denominator. Receipt of appropriate care is separate from symptoms/function/quality-of-life, harms and burden.
No favorable effect, effect size, causality, software efficacy or equity improvement is asserted.
visual: Dashed links converge above the access card and then connect access to health without crossing text.
All titles, measure labels and footer are legible; no clipping or collisions.
visual_findings.caption: Explicitly states that dashed connections do not establish causation; preserves separate follow-up for health/experience and average benefit versus equity.

visual_findings.render_basis: 504-point width in builder; PNG 2100 pixels at 300 dpi, corresponding to 7 inches.
content: All six existing O-IDs are present in their existing order and explicitly described as unranked proposals.
O-04 targets research reproducibility and reliability, not patient treatment benefit. O-02 targets evaluation/shared decisions, not claimed fracture prevention.
O-03 remains non-drug authorization. O-05 measures receipt/fit/use. O-06 measures understanding and preference-concordant care.
Footer preserves existing-service comparison, harms, burden, equitable reach, implementation and buyer need.
visual: Consistent card sizes and colors show no scores or benefit ranking.
All domain titles and wrapped workflow/outcome lines are visible and legible; no clipping or collisions.
visual_findings.caption: Proposed digital-product effects remain unestablished, evidence does not transfer automatically between domains, and software payment/demand/profitability are not inferred.

minor_findings.observed_text: Original Medicare service/code research with a sex-related valuation question and defensible comparators.
minor_findings.issue: Original Medicare may be read as the fee-for-service benefit rather than as original research, despite the caption explicitly retaining Medicare Advantage and Part D.
minor_findings.suggestion: Original service/code research involving Medicare with a sex-related valuation question and defensible comparators.
minor_findings.final_text: Original service/code research involving Medicare, with a sex-related valuation question and defensible comparators.
minor_findings.verified_by: Original-resolution visual reinspection of final figure2_eligibility_criteria.png

caption_notes.finding: Caption explicitly treats unique PMIDs as report records, selected register and intervention retrieval as separate routes, and selection counts as unfinished. Quantitative search/source records were not independently re-audited in this visual task.
Caption identifies a project-developed framework after exploratory review, separates benefit, equity and feasibility, and avoids score/profitability claims.

limitations: Only the five listed PNGs were visually viewed in this task; Figures 4 and 7 received caption-only review.
No physical print, color-vision simulation or final manuscript page-layout check performed here.
Source-ID matching and local-source conceptual checks do not constitute independent screening or verification of scientific article results.
QA applies to the recorded image hashes; changed images require renewed visual inspection.
verification_summary: All five reviewed final PNGs and SVG hashes match the final current manifest. Text is at least 9 points at the intended 7-inch width; no material visual/content issues remain.
